brief: Split the deprecated http.target value into the separate url.path, url.query and url.fragment attributes.

inputs.brief: Deprecated attribute holding the path, the query string and the fragment in one value.

outputs.brief: The URI path component of http.target.
The query string of http.target, without the leading question mark.
The fragment of http.target, without the leading number sign.

actions: If url.path, url.query or url.fragment is already present, keep it and do not overwrite it.
Read http.target as a relative URI reference.
Split off the fragment at the first number sign. Write the part after it, without the number sign, to url.fragment. Do not set url.fragment when there is no number sign.
Split the remaining value at the first question mark.
Write the part before the question mark to url.path.
Write the part after the question mark, without the question mark, to url.query. Do not set url.query when there is no question mark.
Remove http.target once the deprecated attribute is normalized.
